deliverable: M6 P4 -- 1/f gate noise via Ramsey/echo filter functions
theory: Ithier et al., Phys. Rev. B 72, 134519 (2005): first-order Gaussian filter-function integrals (Ramsey log / echo ln2) and the exact quadratic-coupling determinant at second order.

params.noise_convention: S_nu(w) = A^2/|w| two-sided angular; <dnu^2> = 2 A^2 ln(w_uv/w_ir); one-sided ordinary-frequency equivalent 2 A^2 / f
params.A_units: filling factor nu (electrons per moire cell), free parameter
params.w_uv_convention: Nyquist of the exact-determinant time grid, w_uv = pi M / t (second order only; <0.1% effect)
params.T2_definition: chi(T2) = 1, same definition for Ramsey and echo
params.crossover: maps_s uses chi_total = chi_1 + chi_2 (independent rates, as prescribed; the linear-quadratic cross term is dropped). The exact linear+quadratic Gaussian result is carried alongside in the npz as T2_*_exact; see additivity_diagnostic below.

literature_note: A is the 1/f amplitude of the filling-fraction noise in the convention S_nu(w) = A^2/|w| (two-sided, angular), i.e. <dnu^2> = 2 A^2 ln(w_uv/w_ir); A is a FREE PARAMETER and is swept over 1e-6..1e-2 in units of nu (electrons per moire cell). It has never been measured for a TBG junction. For orientation only, and explicitly NOT as a calibration: 1/f charge noise in conventional superconducting circuits is quoted around 1e-4..1e-3 e (rms per e-fold at 1 Hz) and 1/f flux noise around 1 uPhi0 [Astafiev et al., PRL 93, 267007 (2004); Ithier et al., PRB 72, 134519 (2005)]. Neither maps onto dnu for a gated 2D-material device: here dnu is produced by gate-voltage noise, charge traps in the hBN/substrate dielectric stack, and moire-domain rearrangement, and electrostatic-gate 1/f in 2D-material devices is strongly device- and fabrication-dependent. Every T2 in this deliverable is therefore reported as a function of A; no absolute TBG coherence number is claimed.
claim_discipline: Design study. A is free; every T2 is parametric in A. No absolute TBG coherence claim is made.

additivity_diagnostic.definition: T2_exact / T2_additive - 1 (positive = additive is conservative, i.e. under-reports T2)
additivity_diagnostic.note: Independent-rate addition is the prescribed and reported map. It is exact at the apex (D1 = 0) and far off-apex (chi_2 -> 0), and conservative in between. Use the T2_*_exact arrays in the npz for A above the threshold quoted here.
